prompt:
Wanted a text generated in spanish, generates the text in latin

Environment: Windows 11 64 bits
Python used: Python 3.13.2
Faker version used: 
Faker                     37.1.0

When using faker, if you want a text in English (or Italian, for example) it generates the text in English (or Italian) but if you want it in Spanish (es_ES, es_AR, es_MX), it generates the text in latin.

Here an example:

> python
Python 3.13.2 (tags/v3.13.2:4f8bb39, Feb  4 2025, 15:23:48) [MSC v.1942 64 bit (AMD64)] on win32
Type "help", "copyright", "credits" or "license" for more information.
>>> from faker import Faker
>>> faker_en = Faker("en_US")
>>> print(faker_en.text())
Box market fish still development bar. Recently attention actually marriage top.

>>> faker_it = Faker("it_IT")
>>> print(faker_it.text())
Segreto valle in segnare. Vestire palazzo signorina dottore. Possibilità notte costringere fame quarto personaggio.
Pericoloso spirito intendere.

>>> faker_es = Faker("es_ES")
>>> print(faker_es.text())
Necessitatibus consectetur nostrum ducimus vero ut eius placeat. Accusamus iure veritatis autem. Autem nobis itaque adipisci.

>>> faker_es_MX = Faker("es_MX")
>>> print(faker_es_MX.text())
Facilis recusandae eos.
Corrupti quidem pariatur vel earum iste autem. Est tempore ad ut.
Magni eaque culpa voluptates. Corrupti delectus officia praesentium veritatis cum cumque facilis.
